Context: 5. Transport Allowance

With effect from 1-7-2017, Central Government employees who are drawing pay of~ 24,200 and above in Pay Levels 1 and 2 of the Pay Matrix, shall be eligible for grant of Transport Allowance@~ 3,600 plus DA thereon at the cities eligible for higher rates and @ ~ 1,800 plus DA thereon at all Other Places. - Order 2, Appendix 5.
